policy: Only the explicitly listed own notes and clean receipts may be considered for a public audit package. This is eligibility, not authorization to publish/commit, and grants no mathematical/priority clearance. Provenance incident and final-assessment addendum must accompany first or final scientific notes.

exclusion_reasons.private/**: All third-party PDFs/HTML/text/renders/raw HTTP headers and any raw failures/stderr remain private.
exclusion_reasons.*.py: Internal acquisition/inventory/provenance tools are outside own-notes/clean-receipts allowlist.
exclusion_reasons.RESEARCH_LOG.md: Changed original path; preserved named copy and incident documentation are the explicit public candidates.
exclusion_reasons.RESEARCH_LOG_FIRST_SEAL_RECONSTRUCTED.md: Failed unauthenticated recovery attempt retained for transparent whole-file inventory only.
